input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us. Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms we are free to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier and operate in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment has been made. Section 2.1 similarly disclaims any minimum purchase commitment. The only competition-related restraints run against Brightline (§ 12.4 barring Vendor from developing a service competing with our analytics products during the term, and § 24 restricting assignment to a competitor), which benefit us and are not flagged. This meets the preferred position; no redline needed.
